title: Driving Fine but Needs Tuning
summary: Feedback in this topic mostly contains vague statements that the car drives fine, with a smaller set of clearly positive remarks about enjoyable performance and no clearly negative examples.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car for driving without issues and delivering balanced power and agility that make it enjoyable to drive.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly make brief or ambiguous comments that the car, chassis, service, or driving feel fine, while a few mention needing more tuning without enough context to classify sentiment confidently.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are very short and lack context, so the underlying sentiment is often unclear.
This topic mixes driving feel, chassis, suspension tuning, and even service comments, so it is not fully coherent as a single theme.
The examples are stratified samples rather than representative estimates of all reviews.
